value: Tedious fetch quest RPG with a large amount of koikatsu scenes

About to be hit by a car, you are transported to another world by the Goddess of Light to fight the emerging Demon Lord. When you are summoned to the kingdom the spell malfunctions and transports you at a tiny size. You are repeatedly mistaken for a bug and exterminated.
